release secret scan

scenarios.case: installed + signed-in recipient opens a cold challenge link
scenarios.notes: Link resolved read-only to the exact challenger, sign-in not requested, no tab navigation.

scenarios.case: installed + signed-out recipient opens a cold challenge link
scenarios.notes: Challenge context kept; email-code sign-in completed and returned to the same token.

scenarios.case: warm link delivered to the running app interrupts the shell
scenarios.notes: Intent delivered to the top-most instance; persisted pending request resumed after process restart.

scenarios.case: not-installed recipient follows an HTTPS link and installs via Play
scenarios.notes: Emulator image has no Play Store and no real HTTPS host (D1). Install-referrer parsing and recovery copy covered by host tests only. Owner: task 11 (R2/R4).

scenarios.case: process restart resumes the pending challenge and the stored session
scenarios.notes: Stored session restored and profile loaded after restart; pending request context survived.

scenarios.case: expired email code keeps the challenge and offers a fresh request
scenarios.notes: Showed 'That code is invalid or expired. Request a new one.' with the challenge preserved.

scenarios.case: Play Install Referrer recovery
scenarios.notes: Requires Play Store install path. Owner: task 11 (R4).

scenarios.case: multiple recipients, revoked link, username change, expired request, completed link, blocked user, busy player
scenarios.notes: Covered by widget/unit tests and pgTAP adversarial suites. Not re-run on device in this pass.

scenarios.case: notification allowed/denied, duplicate notification tap, challenger offline
scenarios.notes: No Firebase project or google-services.json in this build (push flag false by design); live push not executable locally. Owner: task 11 (R4).

scenarios.case: camera permission allowed and tracking pipeline runs
scenarios.notes: CameraX preview + on-device detector started; emulated scene contains no human body, so no rep was produced. Not accuracy evidence.

scenarios.case: camera permission denied
scenarios.notes: Chip 'Permission denied' plus 'Open Settings and allow the camera' copy.

scenarios.case: camera permission permanently denied
scenarios.notes: Host tests cover the derived state; device double-denial sequence not executed.

scenarios.case: no camera, bad framing, tracking loss, practice reset, lifecycle pause/resume
scenarios.notes: 'Looking for you' framing state observed on device. Other failure paths covered by host tests only.

scenarios.case: physical-device rep counting accuracy and false-positive gate
scenarios.notes: No physical camera device attached. The signed checklist is empty. This blocks enabling camera-counted release. Owner: task 11 (R1).

scenarios.case: both-ready gate
scenarios.notes: App blocked ready until a practice rep (honest notice). Server countdown started only after both API ready calls; no unattended start.

scenarios.case: countdown, 60-second round and tie
scenarios.notes: starts_at->ends_at exactly 60.000 s; receipt draw, reason round_complete; both players' last_seen within 1 s of the end.

scenarios.case: single-player 10-second recovery, shared service failure, abandoned preparing
scenarios.notes: Leave in preparing produced a no_result receipt with reason abandoned_preparing; 10 s outlier window and shared outage covered by tests.

scenarios.case: empty ranked matchmaking at 15 s and 60 s
scenarios.notes: 15 s alternative and 60 s stop verified after the queue-anchor fix; retry control present. Counter bug fixed (defect 4).

scenarios.case: switch to friend cancellation
scenarios.notes: Switch opened the friend challenge and left zero active queue seats for the player.

scenarios.case: confirmed casual receipt, history/leaderboard/profile updates
scenarios.notes: History shows both confirmed receipts with the server reason; casual keeps rating unchanged; leaderboard and profile render server values.

scenarios.case: confirmed ranked receipt and no double rating
scenarios.notes: Ranked device pairing not executed; Elo/idempotency/one-receipt rules covered by pgTAP and host tests. Pilot item for task 11 (R6).

scenarios.case: result sharing to destination apps, copy link, URL/QR correctness
scenarios.notes: Preview-first for 1080x1920 and 1080x1350; clipboard overlay showed https://example.invalid/c/<token>; Android chooser opened. Share-sheet opening recorded separately from referral.

scenarios.case: no raw video export
scenarios.notes: Export is a RepaintBoundary PNG only; no camera frames exist on disk by construction and tests.

scenarios.case: RLS and adversarial API cases, retries, idempotency, no double rating
scenarios.notes: Local stack with fake @arena.invalid accounts; 184 pgTAP assertions and 16 HTTP smoke checks passed.

scenarios.case: link opened -> sign-in -> request -> accepted -> both ready -> battle completed
scenarios.notes: Segments measured; automation latency excluded where separable. See REPORT.md metrics table.

fixed_defects.title: Account feature did not compile (nullable errors, missing imports, missing widget import)
fixed_defects.repro: flutter analyze before 2026-09-18 11:34; 23 issues including undefined AccountLoadingRows and ArenaProfile
fixed_defects.fix: Repaired imports/nullable flows in lib/account; analyzer now clean.

fixed_defects.title: New account received link:null from profile and the waiting poll failed malformed, so accepted matches were never detected
fixed_defects.repro: Signed-in new user sends a request; fix waits; profile returns link null; client throws malformed_response and never reads active_match_id.
fixed_defects.fix: accountSnapshot() now calls the documented link_rotate action when no durable link exists; tests added.

fixed_defects.title: BattleRuntime.fromConfig created a different viewer notifier than the controller, so the production battle snapshot never knew the viewer; an absent-viewer receipt rendered as a personal loss
fixed_defects.repro: Cold start with a finished receipt; result headline read '@opponent beat me' even when the server winner was the viewer.
fixed_defects.fix: fromConfig now shares one notifier with the controller; unknown-viewer receipts render neutral, factual copy; regression tests added.

fixed_defects.title: Ranked search counter stayed at 0 s and the 15 s friend alternative never triggered because queue replies carry no server clock
fixed_defects.repro: Battle tab -> Find an opponent; wait 18 s; card still shows 0 s / 60 s.
fixed_defects.fix: Anchor on the local clock once when the reply has no server_now, reset per search; regression test added; verified on device (16 s / 60 s).

fixed_defects.title: Local email sign-in delivered a magic link without a numeric code, so the app's code flow could not complete
fixed_defects.repro: Request an email code against the local stack; Mailpit shows only a magic link.
fixed_defects.fix: Added supabase/templates/magic_link.html with {{ .Token }} and the additive auth.email.template.magic_link config; restarted the local stack; sign-in completed on device.

blockers.title: Physical-device camera rep accuracy is unvalidated
blockers.impact: Blocks enabling ARENA_FEATURE_CAMERA_COUNTING=true in the pilot; no device accuracy claim may be made.
blockers.action: Execute docs/camera/CAMERA_QA.md section 4 on the physical device matrix and sign qa/camera/device_validation_checklist.md.

blockers.title: Real HTTPS link domain (D1) missing; App Links unverified and release check fails
blockers.impact: Not-installed recipients cannot be recovered through a verified App Link; release check_app_links --release fails.
blockers.action: Supply the real domain, assetlinks.json and signing fingerprint; task 11 gate.

blockers.title: Google sign-in credentials/redirect not configured
blockers.impact: Google auth return path not executable locally; only email-code sign-in was exercised.
blockers.action: Configure the Supabase Google provider and ARENA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URL; run the cold/warm redirect QA.

blockers.title: Push notifications and Play Install Referrer cannot be exercised locally
blockers.impact: Notification allowed/denied/duplicate-tap and not-installed recovery have host-test evidence only.
blockers.action: Configure FCM, google-services.json, a test track install and run the notification/referrer matrix.

blockers.title: Release secret scan fails on synthetic PEM fixtures
blockers.impact: CI release gate is red until resolved; material is explicitly synthetic test data, so secret exposure risk is low.
blockers.action: Exclude known test fixture paths or replace the PEM-shaped fixtures with scanner-safe markers; re-run secret_scan.mjs.

blockers.title: Ranked queue pairing and ranked receipt not exercised on a device with two live clients
blockers.impact: Ranked device path (paired queue, rating update, rematch) rests on host tests and pgTAP, not device evidence.
blockers.action: Run a coordinated two-device ranked match in the invited-pair pilot and record receipts.

blockers.title: Device matrix limited to a single API 34 emulator
blockers.impact: API 24-26 behaviour, low-end performance and the Pixel 6/Tensor beta5 crash risk are unverified.
blockers.action: Run the physical matrix including a low-end API 24-26 device and the Tensor checkpoint.

blockers.title: Shared checkout remains uncommitted
blockers.impact: All task work is uncommitted on the shared branch; a reset could lose the integrated fixes.
blockers.action: Commit the integrated tree after the release checks pass; task 10 does not commit by policy.
